\section{Introduction}\label{sec:introduction}

Economic manuscripts commonly combine linked sections, displayed equations,
figures, tables, and author--year citations. The synthetic design here follows
that ordinary structure. The discussion cites the potential-outcomes notation
of \citet{rubin1974} and a standard difference-in-differences reference
\citep{cardkrueger1994}. No claim or estimate is drawn from a research project.

\Cref{sec:methods} defines the estimand, and \cref{sec:results} presents the
invented results.
